_comment: The TSPML mod catalog. A CURATED LIST, not a search index: there is no
backend behind it, so there are no ratings, no download counts, and no
version history. The UI says so where it is browsed.
Read through lib/registry.ts, which validates every row and DROPS anything
malformed rather than defaulting it. tests/registry.test.ts validates this
file in CI, so a bad commit fails before it deploys.
source.url may be relative. It resolves against whatever origin serves this
file, which is why a portal-served entry would be relative — but the entries
below are hosted by their authors, so they install identically from local dev
and production. A hardcoded tspml.vercel.app URL here would make a local dev
server install from production and look like it worked.
'format' is required and load-bearing: it chooses the import walk AND is the
loader-format tag every card shows (derived, never hand-written into 'tags' —
see entryTags). 'tspml' runs natively; 'pml' installs through the
compatibility adapter in lib/pml/, which carries lifecycle hooks, keybinds
and settings but refuses mixins per call. installCaveat() says so at the
Install button. Adding an entry is a PR.
THE PML ROWS BELOW ARE MIRRORED FROM PML'S OWN REGISTRY:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/polytrackmods/PolyLibrary/refs/heads/main/modlist.json
Names, authors, tags and URLs come from that file; nothing is invented. PML's
registry carries no descriptions at all, so each 'summary' below was written
from the mod's actual source, and each 'gameVersions' lists what that mod's
own index manifest offers — NOT a range we wish it supported. Six of the
twenty have no 0.6.2 build and say so in their summary rather than failing
at the Install button with the player wondering why.
The portal's own /sample-mod, /sample-mod-b, /sample-pml-mod and
/sample-pack.txt fixtures are deliberately NOT catalog entries. They exist
for the Playwright smokes, which need same-origin URLs that cannot rot with
someone else's repo; a catalog listing them would advertise demo content to
players.

entries.name: Poly To Track
entries.author: roowus
entries.summary: Import 3D files (STL/OBJ) — colored models supported — and build them as PolyTrack block builds: position a viewport ghost with Blender-style transform handles, then apply. Schematica for PolyTrack.

entries.name: PML Core
entries.author: Orangy
entries.summary: PolyModLoader's own core mod: the mod-management and settings UI that other PML mods hang their options off. Large, and mostly UI wiring rather than game patching.

entries.name: Car Switcher
entries.author: Orangy
entries.summary: Adds a Select Car button that swaps the player car for a different glTF model, with engine audio to match. The car-model mods below register their cars through this one.

entries.name: Heads Up Splits
entries.author: Orangy
entries.summary: Shows your split against the ghost at each checkpoint, as a heads-up overlay rather than a table. Size, height, opacity and a speed split are settings.

entries.name: Mid Run Ghost Toggle
entries.author: Cwcinc + Orangy
entries.summary: A keybind (O by default) that hides and shows the ghost car without leaving the run. The keybind registers through the adapter; the ghost-hiding itself is a mixin, so it is refused and reported.

entries.name: X Decimal Speedometer
entries.author: Sebas + Orangy
entries.summary: Sets how many decimal places the speedometer shows, as a setting. The setting registers through the adapter; the speedometer rewrite itself is a mixin, so it is refused and reported.

entries.name: No Italics
entries.author: Orangy
entries.summary: Removes the italic slant from the game's fonts. Entirely a CSS mixin — through TSPML's adapter it installs, loads, and does nothing, which the load summary reports by name.

entries.name: Poly Proxy
entries.author: Orangy
entries.summary: A do-nothing placeholder mod. Its 0.6.2 build is an empty class with a comment — useful as a PML smoke test, not as a feature.

entries.name: PolyProcessing
entries.author: Jakob
entries.summary: A post-processing stack over the game's WebGL output: exposure, contrast, saturation, gamma, tint, bloom, tonemapping, LUTs and grayscale, behind a keybind-opened panel.

entries.name: Xenon
entries.author: Jakob
entries.summary: A library, not a visible feature: it captures the game's WebGL context and hooks requestAnimationFrame so other graphics mods can draw at end of frame. Install it because something else needs it.

entries.name: PolyCinema
entries.author: Hero, Jakob
entries.summary: Letterbox bars at a chosen aspect ratio, toggled with a keybind — for recording. Beta. Needs Xenon.

entries.name: Input Overlay
entries.author: Jakob
entries.summary: Draws your steering, throttle and brake inputs on screen, sized and placed by setting — the overlay streamers use.

entries.name: F1 Cars
entries.author: Jakob
entries.summary: Formula 1 car models (Mercedes W14, McLaren MP4/5, Aston Martin AMR23 and more) added to Car Switcher's list. Needs Car Switcher.

entries.name: PolyDebug
entries.author: Aeritalia
entries.summary: A developer console for mod authors: an in-game log screen, a crash screen, a mod-state inspector and a localStorage editor, opened by keybind.

entries.name: PML API
entries.author: Orangy
entries.summary: A library other PML mods build on: sound, model and block registration plus a car-model API. Install it because something else needs it, and note that it is largely mixins — the part of PML the adapter cannot carry across.

entries.name: Cool Cars
entries.author: Jakob
entries.summary: Extra car models for Car Switcher. Needs Car Switcher.

entries.name: Goofy Cars
entries.author: Jakob
entries.summary: Joke car models for Car Switcher. Needs Car Switcher.

entries.name: PolyBlocks
entries.author: Jakob
entries.summary: Adds custom blocks to the track editor. Beta.

entries.name: Advanced PolyEditor
entries.author: Cwcinc + Jakob + Orangy
entries.summary: Track-editor tools beyond the built-in ones.

entries.name: PolyDip--
entries.author: DoraChad + Orangy
entries.summary: Built for the PolyDip 2 community event.

entries.name: Poly Library
entries.author: DoraChad
entries.summary: A helper library for PML mod authors. Install it because something else needs it.
